title: ArmorIQ Cookbook recipe manifest (recipe.yaml)
description: Describes one recipe. Spec: docs/specs/0002-recipe-metadata-manifest.md. Allowed values for framework, language, products, use_case, demonstrates, requires.services, and tested_with keys live in schema/taxonomy.yaml and are checked by the validator, not this schema.

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Always 1 for now; bumped only on a breaking change.

title.description: The recipe's title. Must equal the README's first '# ' heading.

summary.description: One sentence shown in the index table.

framework.description: What runs the agent loop (spec 0001 runner test). A key of taxonomy.frameworks; must equal path segment 1.

language.description: Language of the main entry point. A key of taxonomy.languages; must equal path segment 2.

variant.description: TypeScript lane only: whether the code is plain JavaScript (js) or TypeScript (ts). Taken from the entry point's file extension.

tier.description: official (maintained by ArmorIQ and run live; also needs an entry in .github/official-recipes.txt) or community.

products.description: ArmorIQ products the recipe uses. Keys of taxonomy.products.

use_case.description: The one use case category the index groups this recipe under. A key of taxonomy.use_cases.

demonstrates.description: ArmorIQ outcomes the README's demo output shows. Keys of taxonomy.outcomes.

authors.description: GitHub handles of the people who wrote the recipe.

tested_with.description: Exact versions of ArmorIQ packages the recipe was tested with. Keys of taxonomy.packages; values must equal the lockfile's resolved versions. Quote the versions.

requires.description: What a reader needs before running the recipe.

services.description: External accounts whose credentials appear in .env.example. Keys of taxonomy.services.

external.description: Anything the reader must clone, deploy, or sign up for that is not a taxonomy service.

secondary.description: Other frameworks or languages the recipe uses besides the primary ones.

frameworks.description: Keys of taxonomy.frameworks, never equal to framework.

languages.description: Keys of taxonomy.languages, never equal to language.

siblings.description: Recipe IDs of the same recipe for other hosts or languages. Each must exist.

moved_from.description: Recipe IDs this recipe used to live at.

status.description: active (default) or deprecated. deprecated needs a deprecation_note.

deprecation_note.description: Why the recipe is deprecated and what to use instead. Only with status: deprecated.
